en.processHeading: How website development works in Plovdiv
en.processIntro: AR Studio is based in Plovdiv and works with businesses in the city and across Bulgaria. We start with a short conversation about the goal, agree on scope and follow clear steps through launch.

processSteps.title: A short conversation about the goal
processSteps.description: We clarify which services the website should present, who it is for, and what action it should make easier: a call, enquiry, booking, or purchase.

processSteps.title: Page structure and content
processSteps.description: We organize pages and information so visitors can quickly understand what you offer and how to contact you. Page count and required functions are part of the agreed scope.

processSteps.title: Design and development
processSteps.description: We build a responsive layout for phones, tablets, and desktop. Contact forms, WhatsApp/Viber, and other elements are included according to the agreed plan.

processSteps.title: Checks before launch
processSteps.description: We check the mobile layout, contact forms, and core SEO elements before the website is published.

processSteps.title: Handover and next steps
processSteps.description: We hand over the finished website and explain the main steps for using it. If you need help after launch, we can discuss suitable maintenance.

en.faqHeading: Web design in Plovdiv: frequently asked questions

faq.question: What is the starting price for a website?
faq.answer: The basic one-page plan starts at €249. Multi-page websites, online stores and additional integrations are priced according to scope; see all plans on the Services page.

faq.question: What is included in the basic plan?
faq.answer: One custom-designed page, responsive layout, contact form, WhatsApp/Viber integration, technical SEO foundations and a stated turnaround of 3 working days.

faq.question: Do you work only with businesses in Plovdiv?
faq.answer: No. AR Studio is based in Plovdiv and works with businesses across Bulgaria. Local clients can speak directly with the team, while remote projects follow the same clear process.

faq.question: Do you guarantee a specific Google ranking?
faq.answer: We do not promise a specific ranking or number of clients. We build technical SEO foundations; visibility also depends on content, competition, site authority and other factors.
